audit.whatIsWrong: The entire level chart was a flat template: all seven rows read 'Master Yi' in both layers at 3/10 and 2/10, while the packet chart says Locke owns levels 1-3, rows 3-4 are even and only the last two are his. The page's own whys already said exactly that ('Your bully era', 'Level 3 stays yours', 'Levels 4-5 even out').
audit.why: A 50.6% win rate cannot sit under a chart that hands the enemy every row, and the prose contradicted the sides on five of seven rows.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to the packet chart, with the five affected ratings corrected and phases[0..4].why rewritten to explain each row. The mirror masteryi__locke made the identical seven-row correction on its side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item whys were generic template lines that never named his spikes.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 but its cooldown is reduced by his basic attacks, so his answer returns faster as his attack speed ramps — that is what flips rows 3-4 from yours to even. Wuju Style adds true damage from level 1 of the skill and Highlander is 85s.
audit.corrected: phases[1..4].why rewritten around the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says four separate times that Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges your Purgatory, and tells you to aim the totem at his Meditate instead. Purgatory grounds, and Alpha Strike is flagged as a dash — the zone denies the dash outright. Separately, Highlander makes him 'immune to all slowing effects', which turns off both your Q slow and your R slow, and that was never stated anywhere.
audit.why: Holding your ultimate for a window that grounding already covers wastes a 120s cooldown, and a kiting plan built on slows is a plan that stops working the moment he presses R.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into report[5].t, spikes[1].text, phases[4].why, whys[4], wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1]; the slow immunity into report[5].t, phases[4].why and whys[4].

edits.before: Q nails on the wave contacts only — you are a 125-range mana champ in a lane of stat-checkers. Chip, mark, and touch nothing.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours: a melee kit with no items and one 20s Alpha Strike cannot answer nails thrown from outside his reach. Tax him.

edits.before: E online, but spending it to trade means walking home without an exit. Blink-auto only when his engage tool is already down.
edits.after: E is online and his only answer is a 20s Alpha Strike — poke, mark, and slide out before his attack chain gets going on you.

edits.before: Full kit: W speed makes short trades stick. Stack nails at max range, bite once, and leave before the lane's HP bars start negotiating.
edits.after: Full kit and he still has none: nails into the W bite chunk a bare melee frame, and your blink leaves his engage landing on empty ground.

edits.before: Q max ramps the recast slows — kite the melee war and tax every step he takes toward the wave. Your passive quietly wins the sub-50% zone.
edits.after: Evens out: his basic attacks refund Alpha Strike's cooldown, so the answer you used to farm through returns faster every level he gains.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds, so Alpha Strike cannot dash out of it — but Highlander makes him slow-immune, so your kiting half stops working.

edits.before: Level 6 is a skill window - your totem executes his commit, but Alpha Strike can dodge the killing beat.
edits.after: Level 6 is a skill window - your totem grounds his dash, but Highlander shrugs off both your slows.

edits.before: A skill window: your R Purgatory totem executes a committed Yi, but Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge the killing beat - drop the totem on his Meditate, not his dash.
edits.after: A skill window: your R Purgatory grounds, so a committed Yi cannot Alpha Strike out of the zone - but his untargetable frames still eat a cast thrown into them, so drop it after the dash.

edits.before: Track Master Yi’s Alpha Strike: Untargetable blink that dodges your key spell — bait it before committing your burst. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Alpha Strike is a dash and Purgatory grounds it; its untargetable frames only beat a cast you throw into them. Highlander makes him immune to your slows.

edits.before: R Purgatory timed on Meditate, not Alpha Strike
edits.after: R Purgatory after his dash — it grounds the next

edits.after: Alpha Strike out before the totem grounds

notes: This was the worst page in my slice: a seven-row template chart that handed Master Yi every level while the prose on the same rows said the opposite, plus four separate lines instructing the reader to spend a 120s ultimate working around a dash that the ultimate's own grounding denies. Both are now corrected in matched pairs. Note that phases[5] and phases[6] already read Master Yi at 2/10, which matches the packet, so those two rows needed no edit. 'Silver Stake' and 'Ritual Nails' appear here too and were left alone — they need one ruling from the user rather than per-page guesses.
